The physician may be found liable if the patient had undiagnosed cervical osteoarthritis, which is an absolute contraindication to neck treatment, and the physician performed articulatory springing technique without first ruling it out. Liability would also arise if the technique caused or worsened a vertebral artery dissection or stroke, or if the physician failed to warn of serious risks or respond appropriately to the patient’s deterioration.
